verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com that indexes the Mesh documentation. The docs pages are also served as raw Markdown with an agentTools frontmatter pointing to that llms.txt as the projectIndex, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. A downloadable OpenAPI schema adds machine-readable API detail. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on how to use these agent-oriented docs, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt variant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
